related.description: C++ image processing and machine learning library with using of SIMD: SSE, AVX, AVX-512, AMX  for x86/x64, NEON for ARM.
Implementations of SIMD instruction sets for systems which don't natively support them.
Unicode routines (UTF8, UTF16, UTF32) and Base64: billions of characters per second using SSE2, AVX2, NEON, AVX-512, RISC-V Vector Extension...
Roaring bitmaps in C (and C++), with SIMD (AVX2, AVX-512 and NEON) optimizations: used by Apache Doris, ClickHouse, Alibaba Tair, Redpanda,...
